author: Ricardo Sanchez
title: Ukraine-Russia War: Ukrainian Forces Fire at Gorlovka, Russian Forces Gain Control in Eastern Regions
text: Ukrainian armed forces fired at Gorlovka approximately twenty times throughout the day using various types of ammunition, according to the governor of the Donetsk People’s Republic. This resulted in civilian injuries and damage to residential homes in the city’s Central City and Nikitovsky districts. General-Colonel Sergei Rudskoy later reported that Russian forces control 75% of Donetsk, Zaporizhzhia, and Kherson regions. A Ukrainian mortar soldier also shared his story of defecting from the Ukrainian military with the help of his grandmother.
